answer: Standing decays 2% per epoch without an answer or an attestation. Linking two identities resets both scores to zero, and a jury must draw from 3 unrelated subnetworks, so co-located clones cannot fill a panel. An operator parking 50 clones through a quiet tide loses 2% an epoch and falls out of jury eligibility inside 12 epochs, and the clone that votes as a block from one canyon of matching addresses triggers the reset first. An honest agent keeps its sonnet of signed receipts and the decay never bites.
